rules.name: PR review requests for anyone other than this pool's identity (all of them when identity is unset)
never review a PR this pool's identity authored
comments and review chatter authored by a bot (sender.login; see the pack README)
rules.expr: (.payload.sender.login // "") as $s | (.kind | IN("issue_comment", "pull_request_comment")) and any((($params.bot_actors // []) | arrays)[] | strings; . == $s)

rules.name: approved/rejected notifications from a bot reviewer (sender.login; see the pack README)
rules.expr: (.payload.sender.login // "") as $s | (.kind | IN("pull_request_approved", "pull_request_rejected")) and any((($params.bot_actors // []) | arrays)[] | strings; . == $s)

rules.name: review outcomes on PRs this identity did not author; keeps its own (see the pack README)
